episodes.synopsis: Seeing everyone turning into Ice Oni, there is nothing that the samurai warriors can do other than grieve. However, it wasn’t just them who were devastated by Queen’s raging virus. When their desperation and frustration peak, they hear a hopeful voice.
episodes.title: All Set! Chopperphage Nebulizer!

episodes.synopsis: That unparalleled laugh! The Akazaya regain hope upon witnessing Oden's return. They failed in their attempt to take down Kaido, but after twenty years, they team up with Oden again to finish the job!
episodes.title: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!

episodes.synopsis: The Akazaya members run to save Momonosuke, but an unexpected contender stands in their way. Queen gets infuriated after Chopper ruined his plot and goes after him. Meanwhile, on the rooftop, Kaido and Big Mom unleashes a combination attack on Luffy and the others.
episodes.title: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors` Deadly Attack!

episodes.synopsis: The iron hammer of the Conqueror will lead the people to hell. Badly injured, Luffy and the others know what to do with Kaido. To start a new era, they will do something desperate that paralyzes the Emperors.
episodes.title: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!

episodes.synopsis: Even after Big Mom was pushed off of the island, Zoro and the others keep fighting the exhausting battle against Kaido. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack at the risk of his life.
episodes.title: Defend Luffy! Zoro and Law`s Sword Technique!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy remembers how he was advised by his friends, how he was saved by his comrades, and the frustrations of being defeated. As Kaido mocks him to his face, the Color of the Supreme King Haki gushes out and they clash again.
episodes.title: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!

episodes.synopsis: A young Luffy who has been dreaming about getting out of Windmill Village one day to accomplish something great meets a young girl named Uta who came along with Shanks and the Red-Hair Pirates calling herself the musician of the pirate group.
episodes.title: A Faint Memory! Luffy and Red-Haired`s Daughter Uta!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and Uta run across Windmill Village, compete with each other, and share their dreams with each other. They also pledge to build a new genesis for everyone to live happily. However, one day, the unexpected happens.
episodes.title: A Pledge for the New Genesis! Luffy and Uta!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and Kaido who have both infused themselves with the Color of the Supreme King clash! Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and Tama are running from Page One to get to the Performance Floor, but they bump into another tough enemy, Big Mom.
episodes.title: Nami Screams - A Deadly Death Race!

episodes.synopsis: Kin’emon and the Akazaya members are rushing to help Momonosuke and everyone else while Yamato leaves Momonosuke and Shinobu in a hide-out to lure away their enemies. At the same time, Ulti tries to avenge her brother against Big Mom.
episodes.title: The Dawn of the Land of Wano - The All-Out Battle Heats Up!

episodes.synopsis: Sanji is forced to run with Zoro on his shoulder. Meanwhile, Nami bravely stands up against Ulti and Big Mom. On the rooftop, the intense battle between Luffy and Kaido finally comes to an end.
episodes.title: The Conclusion! Luffy, Accelerating Fist of the Supreme King

episodes.synopsis: Kaidou's destructive power knocked Luffy down along with his King Haki! The ferocious attacks from the senior officers gradually put the Straw Hats' gang against the wall! After the Captain's fall, is there still hope in Wano Country? Or just despair?!
episodes.title: Luffy, Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!

episodes.synopsis: While the Straw Hats and their allies are all having a hard time, they are shocked by the news that Luffy lost to Kaido. At the same time, Kanjuro closes in on Momonosuke to destroy the Kozuki lineage.
episodes.title: The Animal Kingdom Pirates Trample Down! The End of the Kozuki Clan!

episodes.synopsis: Like all the other samurai, Chopper is discouraged by the news of Luffy’s loss and Queen doesn’t miss the chance to finish him off! Meanwhile, Kin’emon fights for his life to save Momonosuke and that motivates Momonosuke to rise up!
episodes.title: Fight Against the Dark Night - The Commander-in-Chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off

episodes.synopsis: The samurai hold out on the battlefield without Luffy. Kid is in front of Big Mom. Law's fighting spirit is immense. When those determinations come together in the face of adversity, a new power is born that will shatter the status quo.
episodes.title: Believe in Luffy! The Alliance`s Counterattack Begins!

episodes.synopsis: Nami strikes a thunder blast to clear the way to the stage on the Performance Floor. However, the elite corps of the Gifters show up to crush their inferior opponents. Upset but unbroken, Otama stands up to give a command.
episodes.title: Nami`s Lethal Attack! Otama`s Desperate Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: Hearing Otama’s command, the Gifters side with the samurai and upset the Tobi Roppo and others! Chopper starts to take care of Zoro while suffering from the side effect of the enhanced Rumble Ball. Meanwhile, Jimbei gets stunned by Who’s-Who’s story.
episodes.title: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!

episodes.synopsis: Who’s-Who expresses fierce resentment toward Luffy and Jimbei fights back out of his loyalty to Luffy. As Who’s-Who asks Jimbei a question, he tramples on the dignity of the Fish-Men and that sparks Jimbei’s outrage.
episodes.title: The Pride of a Helmsman - The Enraged Jimbei!

episodes.synopsis: To cut ties with Kaido, Yamato unleashes his true power. Meanwhile, Queen repeatedly attacks Sanji with his power as a cyborg, and Sasaki in his Man-Beast Form launches tricky attacks on Franky and drives him into a corner.
episodes.title: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky

episodes.synopsis: Kaido tries to convince Yamato to become the Shogun of the Land of Wano and rule the country with the special power he obtained by accident. Meanwhile, Saul, Professor Clover, and Robin’s mother Olvia suddenly appear in front of her.
episodes.title: The Predator`s Trap - Black Maria`s Temptation

episodes.synopsis: In the dense mist, Brook is surprised to see his old friends, the Rumbar Pirates and Laboon. They reminisce about the old days and play music together, however, they suddenly attack Brook.
episodes.title: Slash the Nightmare - Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!

episodes.synopsis: Black Maria torments Robin both physically and spiritually. As she burns in hellfire, Robin remembers the people who gave her a hard time and the people who supported her, and she as Demon Child shows what she is really capable of.
episodes.title: Clutch! A Demon Incarnate, Robin!

episodes.synopsis: Killer is shocked to find out who Hawkins’ straw doll he slashed represents. Meanwhile, Sanji who is in a hard battle against Queen and King sees enemy brutes going after the injured Zoro, and no one else is there to save him.
episodes.title: A Spell! Kid and Zoro Facing Threats!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro gets back on his feet and along with Sanji, confronts King and Queen, the Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Watching Zoro fight, Hyogoro and Kawamatsu remember someone from way back.
episodes.title: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!

episodes.synopsis: Dogstorm confronts his sworn enemy who destroyed his country. Meanwhile, Cat Viper faces Perospero who is responsible for Pedro’s death. At Tokage Port, Momonosuke roars with his determined eyes.
episodes.title: Ascend to the Dawn! A Pink Dragon Gets Agitated

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Kaidou and Yamato gets intense. Backed into a corner, Yamato remembers three great swordsmen who he met when he was a child. Their stunning choice for the future of the Land of Wano encourages Yamato.
episodes.title: For the Future! Yamato and the Great Swordsmen`s Pledge

episodes.synopsis: Luffy amps up the reluctant Momonosuke, who is afraid of heights, in his giant pink dragon form, to fly and take him to Onigashima in the sky. Meanwhile, Yamato, in a hard battle against Kaido, vows to survive until Luffy returns.
episodes.title: Luffy Soars! Revenge Against the King of the Beasts

episodes.synopsis: Momonosuke faces Kaido once again trembling in fear. However, with Luffy’s encouragement, he bravely steps up and shows his dragon fangs remembering what he had to go through because of Kaido.
episodes.title: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke`s Determination!

episodes.synopsis: Yamato helps Momonosuke conquer his fear of flying and the two take on the most important task of saving Onigashima. Meanwhile, Luffy and Kaidou clash which parts the heavens. The clear skies help Inuarashi and Nekomamushi finally defeat their foes.
episodes.title: A Legend All Over Again! Luffy`s Fist Roars in the Sky

episodes.synopsis: Realizing Onigashima’s impending threat, imperiling everyone’s life, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation. Meanwhile, Sanji and Zoro are both in a deadly battle against Queen and King.
episodes.title: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!

episodes.synopsis: Queen’s unforeseen move stuns everyone on the Performance Floor. And then, he goes on to utilize another special technique which can break every bone in Sanji’s body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange again.
episodes.title: Sanji`s Mutation - The Two Arms in Crisis!

episodes.synopsis: Killer tries to figure out how to fight against Hawkins whose power enables him to transfer damage against him to Kid. Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from. Killer takes a chance with Kid’s life on the line.
episodes.title: Death to Your Partner! Killer`s Deadly Gamble

episodes.synopsis: Sanji still wonders what is happening to his body as he receives attacks. Meanwhile, the dying Kin’emon hears an unexpected voice calling for the also dying Kanjuro. Through the Smail, the voice of Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.
episodes.title: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames

episodes.synopsis: Law and Kid are having a tough battle against a formidable Emperor of the Sea, Big Mom. However, when they decide to work collaboratively and use their awakened Devil Fruit powers, they see the possibility of taking down the old generation.
episodes.title: A Countercharge! Law and Kid`s Return-Attack Combination

episodes.synopsis: Sanji is tormented by the idea of becoming a cruel Germa warrior like his siblings and torn between being strong or being humane as he is now. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.
episodes.title: For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro`s Oath

episodes.synopsis: The Fiery Monk, materialization of the destructive ire of the Kurozumi clan, continues his deadly descent into the castle and instills fear in both the ranks of Kaido's pirates and those of the samurai. Orochi, all excited by the scenes of panic, suddenly hears a sound that brings back happy memories.
episodes.title: The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi`s Evil Clutches Close In

episodes.synopsis: Zoro is facing a hard fight against King who seems invincible. Even one of Zoro’s deadliest attacks doesn’t leave a scratch on him. On top of that, one of Zoro’s swords goes out of control and gets in his way.
episodes.title: Zoro Faces Adversity - A Monster! King the Wildfire

episodes.synopsis: Zoro still can’t gain control of Enma which keeps extracting his Haki. Backed into a corner by the formidable King, Zoro remembers the encounter with an old man in his hometown when he was a child.
episodes.title: The Secret of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro

episodes.synopsis: Queen’s formidable attacks remind Sanji of his family. Annoyed by Queen’s provocations, Sanji remembers a young woman mysteriously getting hurt in front of him and realizes what happened at that time, which lights a fire within him.
episodes.title: The Strike of an Ifrit! Sanji vs. Queen

episodes.synopsis: Zoro tries to figure out a way to damage King. Meanwhile, King remembers when he first met his captain Kaido and declares that his captain is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.
episodes.title: The Three-Sword Style of the Supreme King! Zoro vs. King

episodes.synopsis: Usopp finds Kin’emon’s upper body and the heavily wounded Kiku. However, they are surrounded by the Gifters and can’t find a way out. Seeing the samurai giving up hope, Usopp remembers his determination.
episodes.title: Luffy Is on the Move! A Turning Point to a New Era!

episodes.synopsis: In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is about to end. On Onigashima, the battle between Luffy and Kaido is getting even more intense. However, Kaido who is excited about having a strong opponent starts drinking too much.
episodes.title: Drunken Dragon Bagua! The Lawless Dragon Closing in on Luffy

episodes.synopsis: Determined to counter the fury of Big Mom, who is about to join Kaido, Kidd and Law must face the imperial omnipotence while in the underground arsenal, Yamato leads the assault against the fiery monk. As the death knell tolls for the final battles, will the rebellion emerge victorious?
episodes.title: The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire Up, the Will of the New Generation!

episodes.synopsis: Big Mom’s strong life force discourages Law and Kid. Law tells Kid that he only has enough energy for one last strike. However, a monster Big Mom summons puts the two in even more of a bind.
episodes.title: Here Comes the Main Act! Powerful Techniques of Shockwave and Magnetism

episodes.synopsis: Kid’s all-out deadly attack and Law’s tactical action leave Big Mom in the lurch. Then she remembers what Roger said in the past and wonders if the treasure he mentioned is out there after all.
episodes.title: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats

episodes.synopsis: Kaido mourns Big Mom’s defeat and remembers the day he met her for the first time. Meanwhile, backed into a corner, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.
episodes.title: Moon Princess Echoes! The Final Phase of the Land of Wano!

episodes.synopsis: On orders from the Five Elders, the CP-0 agent Guernica tries to get to Luffy, but Drake stands in his way. Meanwhile, Luffy who only has very little energy left uses his last Gear Four to emancipate the people of the Land of Wano from Kaido.
episodes.title: There Is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido

episodes.synopsis: The main battle of the dome ends unexpectedly. Running out of a serious fight, a furious Kaido confronts the injured samurai. Now that 20 years of hope have crumbled before his eyes, can they find a way out of hell?
episodes.title: Luffy Is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind

episodes.synopsis: As Luffy’s heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.
episodes.title: Luffy`s Peak - Attained! Gear Five

episodes.synopsis: With his newfound power, Luffy is able to overwhelm Kaidou to the point where he greatly enjoys the battle, shocking Kaidou and his allies alike with his immense power.
episodes.title: The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play

episodes.synopsis: As Luffy and Kaidou continue their battle, Raizo and Jinbe utilize their plan to put out the fire that has spread throughout Onigashima. Meanwhile, Yamato warns Momonosuke of the danger Onigashima will face if he does not act soon to create new flame clouds to keep it from crashing into the Flower Capital.
episodes.title: No Way Out! A Hellish Scene on Onigashima

episodes.synopsis: As Momonosuke struggles to create his own flame clouds, Luffy continues to fight Kaidou. As the Samurai realize what would happen to Onigashima if Luffy won, Orochi is freed from the Seastone Nail and attempts to murder Hiyori. After hearing the voices of the people, Luffy prepares his final attack.
episodes.title: I Trust Momo - Luffy`s Final Powerful Technique!

episodes.synopsis: As Momonosuke is doubting he could move Onigashima out of the way of Luffy's final attack, both he and Kaidou prepare their final strike. As the cruelty of the past twenty years on Wano Country is shown, the alliance prays for Luffy's victory. As Denjiro saves Hiyori from Orochi, the people at the Fire Festival reveal their true wish with their Sky Lanterns.
episodes.title: 20 Years` Worth of Prayers! Take Back the Land of Wano

episodes.synopsis: Kaido remembers how he was treated unfairly in the past and how he believes the world should be. While his friends struggle to survive on Onigashima, Luffy is asked by Kaido to picture his ideal world as he throws a destructive punch.
episodes.title: The World That Luffy Wants!

episodes.synopsis: The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido. Meanwhile, Momonosuke informs Zunesha of a major decision that he made. However, when Yamato calls on the Animal Kingdom Pirates to stop fighting, the earth trembles.
episodes.title: The Curtain Falls! The Winner, Straw Hat Luffy!

episodes.synopsis: The people of the Flower Capital get flustered when Kin’emon and the other Akazaya samurai who were supposed to be dead appear from the smoke. However, the last one who walks out of the smoke, and what he says, confuses the people even more.
episodes.title: He Returns! The Shogun of the Land of Wano, Kozuki Momonosuke

episodes.synopsis: The Land of Wano is in a celebratory mood now that the years of tyranny are over. However, Yamato is holding back his hunger alone until Hiyori arrives with the news he was waiting for. Meanwhile, some unknown figure approaches the Land of Wano.
episodes.title: The Morning Comes! Luffy and the Others Rest!

episodes.synopsis: Tenguyama reveals his true identity as Sukiyaki to Robin and confirms Wano's secret. The new Emperors of the Sea are declared, as Ryokugyu heads after Luffy.
episodes.title: A Celebration Banquet! The New Emperors of the Sea!

episodes.synopsis: As the Navy Admiral Ryokugyu comes to strike the Flower Capital, the Akazaya samurai notice and try to stop him, but his Woods-Woods Fruit power overwhelms them. Meanwhile, another formidable, yet friendly, guest approaches the Land of Wano
episodes.title: The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!

episodes.synopsis: Sukiyaki shows Robin and Law the Road Ponyglyph and tells them more about Wano's history. Momonosuke decides to face Ryokugyu to prove he could defend Wano and successfully uses the Bolo Breath attack. Shanks releases a tremendous burst of Haoshoku Haki to force the admiral to retreat.
episodes.title: The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired`s Imperial Rage

episodes.synopsis: The party is over, and at the castle in the capital of flowers, Kinemon and Kiku are worried about Raizo and Shinobu, who have become thinner due to the battle with the Midori Cow. Meanwhile, Momonosuke and Hiyori come to know Hitetsu's true identity.
episodes.title: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild

episodes.synopsis: An untold story from before the Straw Hats’ departure. Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle where Oden’s grave once was and Zoro visits Yasuie’s grave where he meets Hiyori. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time and share their feelings with each other.
episodes.title: Time to Depart - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hats

episodes.synopsis: Angered by Luffy's attempt to leave without saying goodbye, Momonosuke rushes with Kin’emon and Yamato to the port from where the Straw Hats are about to leave, thinking back on his days with Luffy.
episodes.title: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke`s Vow

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and the other Straw Hats’ new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, at Emptee Bluffs Island, Crocodile and the greatest swordsman in the world Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.
episodes.title: A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!

episodes.synopsis: Navy Captain Koby comes to the Island of Women to arrest Pirate Empress Hancock with the new Pacifistas. While the Navy and Kuja fighters clash, Blackbeard comes to raid, also targeting　Hancock.
episodes.title: The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero

episodes.synopsis: The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.
episodes.title: Luffy`s Dream

episodes.synopsis: The World Government destroys Lulusia Kingdom before Sabo could divulge information about Imu over the Den Den Mushi. Several days later, the Straw Hat Pirates come across a young girl trapped in a Warm Eddy.
episodes.title: Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo`s Paths!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.
episodes.title: A New Island! Future Island Egghead

episodes.synopsis: A young girl who came out of the big robot names herself Dr. Vegapunk and it surprises Franky and the rest of the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Luffy’s group gets to the surface of the island where futuristic buildings stand and unknown giant creatures wander about.
episodes.title: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!

episodes.synopsis: While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.
episodes.title: Bonney`s Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island

episodes.synopsis: The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates’ top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.
episodes.title: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!

episodes.synopsis: Bonney changes the ages of Luffy, Chopper, Jinbe, and hers, so that the Pacifista won't recognize them. Meanwhile, Lilith gives the rest of the crew a tour, and they respond enthusiastically, until someone who looks like Jinbe show up.
episodes.title: The Mystery Deepens! Egghead Labophase

episodes.synopsis: Science offers endless possibilities! Research has already begun! An inscrutable quest for knowledge that confuses the straw hats. Good and evil. Wisdom and greed. Reason and instinct. Talented minds that come from all directions and are now reunited!
episodes.title: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.
episodes.title: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom

episodes.synopsis: Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work. The wish for the future conveyed by the Ohara scholars moves the Straw Hats.
episodes.title: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research

episodes.synopsis: The scientific power of 900 years ago is revealed in front of the iron giant. Vegapunk is fascinated by the energy of an antique and brims with ideas and ideals. What awaits the future you dream of?
episodes.title: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!

episodes.synopsis: CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.
episodes.title: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!

episodes.synopsis: Luffy transforms into the Warrior of Liberation as Rob Lucci also shows his awakened Devil Fruit form. As the two clash, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth of the Gum-Gum Fruit and his eye-opening theory on Devil Fruits.
episodes.title: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk describes how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers, which surprises Franky and the others. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his savage, awakened form, but the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.
episodes.title: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim`s Powers!

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk asks the Straw Hats to take him on board their ship which makes Franky and Usopp happy but annoys Nami. Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk’s escape routes and looks to invade the heavily-secured Labophase.
episodes.title: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead

episodes.synopsis: CP-0 enters the Labophase and starts attacking the Thousand Sunny as soon as they find it. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others but finds out that Vegapunk is missing. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.
episodes.title: Turn Back My Father! Bonney`s Futile Wish!

episodes.synopsis: The Seraphim come following CP-0 to the Labophase, pitting Zoro and Brook against the seven of them. Sanji, Franky, Edison, and Lilith leave the lab to fight them, but the Seraphim launch a full-scale attack on the lab.
episodes.title: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim`s All-out Attack!

episodes.synopsis: Stussy shows her intentions and attacks Lucci. Her unexpected smile confuses the Straw Hats. As the Seraphim continue to attack, the true objective of the mysterious Stussy is revealed.
episodes.title: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy!

episodes.synopsis: About to escape from Egghead, Dr. Vegapunk, key to the mission, suddenly and inexplicably disappears. Where could he have gone if the lab was closed? The Straw Hat crew starts searching for the genius scientist.
episodes.title: Trouble Occurs! Seek Dr. Vegapunk!

episodes.synopsis: Bonney witnesses her father Bartholomew Kuma’s painful memories. Meanwhile at the lab, Shaka notices that their communications and surveillance cameras are being cut off by somebody.
episodes.title: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory

episodes.synopsis: The Seraphim suddenly attack the Straw Hats. They even ignore orders from the satellites. Who is giving them commands? While suspicion falls on Vegapunk's satellites, the Seraphim's attacks corner Luffy and his crew.
episodes.title: Incomprehensible! The Seraphim`s Rebellion!

episodes.synopsis: Lucci and Kaku from CP-0, who came to Egghead with a mission to eliminate the seven Vegapunks, ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but Luffy and Zoro are reluctant to do so.
episodes.title: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!

episodes.synopsis: Zoro realizes that the Seraphim have King's Lunarian abilities. Sanji arrives to help Nami and Brook against S-Shark, and S-Snake partially turns Franky to stone while completely petrifying Usopp and Lilith. Meanwhile, Shaka tracks down Dr. Vegapunk while following a lead, only to be killed by a mysterious assassin.
episodes.title: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!

episodes.synopsis: Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.
episodes.title: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind`s Ambition!

episodes.synopsis: Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. And Shanks also prepares for the battle but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.
episodes.title: Clash! Shanks vs. Eustass Kid

episodes.synopsis: Held at the Pirate Island of Beehive, Koby gets a chance to be free but decides to become a decoy to liberate slaves on the island. Pirates from all over the island come after him because of the big bounty on his head.
episodes.title: Run, Koby! A Desperate Escape Strategy!

episodes.synopsis: A huge warship comes flying towards the pirate island of Hachinosu, and Vice Admiral Garp launches a devastating attack to rescue his student Corby. Corby almost reaches the ship while Frigate Captain Hibari runs alongside him.
episodes.title: For the Beloved Pupil - The Fist of Vice Admiral Garp!

episodes.synopsis:
Kuzan faces Garp, who has come to rescue Koby. 
Why did he join Blackbeard after leaving the Navy? Once Garp's prized student, Kuzan is now a pirate, challenging his former mentor
episodes.title: The Navy Surprised! The Navy Headquarters` Former Admiral, Kuzan

episodes.synopsis: Sengoku, the former Admiral of the Fleet, and Great Adviser Tsuru discuss the murder of Vice Admiral T-Bone and concerns about Cross Guild. Meanwhile, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.
episodes.title: Let`s Go Get It! Buggy`s Big Declaration

episodes.synopsis: Sabo returns to Kamabakka Queendom and starts recounting what happened at the Holy Land Mary Geoise. A month ago, during the Reverie, he and the captains of the Revolutionary Army raided the Land of Gods and Sabo witnessed Bartholomew Kuma being the Celestial Dragons’ slave.
episodes.title: Sabo Returns - The Shocking Truth to Be Told!

episodes.synopsis: In the Holy Land Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Sabo runs into Bartholomew Kuma’s daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.
episodes.title: The Holy Land in Tumult! Sai and Leo`s Full-Power Blow!

episodes.synopsis: King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne and by learning about the truth of the world. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him. The injured king entrusts Sabo with a message.
episodes.title: The Entrusted Message! King Cobra`s Resolve

episodes.synopsis: Sabo, Vivi and Wapol, as well as Bonney all escape from Mary Geoise by stowing away on different ships. Imu decides to test the Mother Flame on Lulusia Kingdom. Sabo finishes his story with what happened at Lulusia Kingdom when it was destroyed. Ivankov suspects that the Imu Sabo met might be one of the First Twenty. Meanwhile at Mary Geoise, Mjosgard is executed by Garling for his earlier actions of defending Otohime's family.
episodes.title: The World Is Shaken! The Ruler`s Judgment and the Five Elders` Actions!

episodes.synopsis: At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp, who came to rescue the kidnapped Koby, deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, Kuzan, the former Navy admiral, stands in their way.
episodes.title: Garp and Kuzan - A Master and a Pupil`s Beliefs Clash

episodes.synopsis: Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.
episodes.title: The Last Lesson! Impact Inherited

episodes.synopsis: As the news spreads throughout the world of Garp's disappearance and the hostage situation regarding Dr. Vegapunk, the repercussions of Lulusia Kingdom's destruction affects the entire world. As Admiral Kizaru's forces surround Egghead, York contacts them to reveal she had been caught by the Straw Hat Pirates.
episodes.title: The World Shakes! The Straw Hats` Hostage Situation

episodes.synopsis: In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Navy, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York’s secret passcode.
episodes.title: Completely Surrounded! The Operation to Escape Egghead

episodes.synopsis: Navy Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall on Egghead and Sentomaru, Vegapunk’s bodyguard, stands in his way. The two men who were once close now clash violently. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others try their best to move the Sunny to the back side of the island to escape.
episodes.title: A Clash of Two Men`s Determination! Kizaru and Sentomaru

episodes.synopsis: Kuma finally reaches Mary Geoise and keeps advancing even without free will or mind. But Fleet Admiral Akainu stands in his way. On Egghead, Kizaru enters the Labophase and delivers a powerful kick to Luffy who tries to stop him.
episodes.title: Looming Despair! Admiral Kizaru`s Depressing Mission

episodes.synopsis: A bizarre battle between Luffy and Kizaru heats up. Meanwhile, in the Fabiriophase, Bonney is all alone and being chased by the Navy soldiers. Dr. Vegapunk sees this and can’t help but leave the Labophase to rescue her, risking his life.
episodes.title: Luffy vs. Kizaru! A Fierce Kaleidoscopic Battle

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk successfully wrests back the Pacifistas from the Navy, but another party soon gains control of them. At the same time, Luffy, Zoro, and the others sense an unearthly presence just as a pentagram suddenly appears on Egghead.
episodes.title: The Nightmare Strikes - Godhead of Science & Defense, St. Saturn

episodes.synopsis: Bonney gets captured by St. Saturn, whose enigmatic power keeps Sanji and Franky from saving her. In St. Saturn's clenched fist, she recalls the memories of her father, Kuma. 47 years ago, Kuma was born to a father of a race on the verge of extinction.
episodes.title: Kuma`s Past - Better Off Dead in This World

episodes.synopsis: The human hunt begins and the Celestial Dragons start chasing locals of God Valley and slaves for prizes. Ivankov and Ginny share with Kuma and the others their surprising plan to survive the game. Meanwhile, ships full of infamous pirates start arriving on the island one after another.
episodes.title: A History Erased! God Valley of Despair

episodes.synopsis: Kuma and Ginny live peacefully in the Sorbet Kingdom eight years after the God Valley Incident. However, their new king initiates a policy of enslaving the poor. Kuma tries to free those who were captured but ends up being imprisoned himself. But a familiar face comes to rescue him.
episodes.title: A Fleeting Moment of Happiness - Kumachi and Ginny

episodes.synopsis: Two years after Ginny’s abduction, the Revolutionary Army suddenly receives a call from her.
episodes.title: A Pledge to Ginny - Kuma Becomes a Father

episodes.synopsis: By fighting off King Bekori who is supported by the World Government, Kuma is put on the wanted list and decides to travel around the world in search of a cure for Bonney's disease. He reunites with Dragon and learns about the Government’s eccentric scientist who might be able to cure Bonney.
episodes.title: To Save His Daughter - Kuma the Timid Pacifist

episodes.synopsis: Taking advantage of Kuma’s love for his daughter Bonney, the World Government imposes three harsh conditions on him in exchange for her treatment. Kuma agrees to them and Bonney’s treatment starts at Laboratory 8 in tandem with the clone development with which Kuma agrees to cooperate.
episodes.title: Cruel Fate - Kuma`s Decision as a Father

episodes.synopsis: Bonney has been waiting for a letter from her father Kuma who promised to write to her. But with no letters in sight, she turns nine and one day realizes her disease is cured. She then decides to go out to sea to search for her father.
episodes.title: To the Sea Where My Father Is! The Future Bonney Chooses

episodes.synopsis: Bonney sails out to sea in search of her father and rises to prominence. At the same time, Luffy makes his name by defeating the Arlong Pirates and declaring war against the World Government. Watching his actions, Kuma begins to hold a certain belief.
episodes.title: "Kuma`s Life"

episodes.synopsis: The present day on Egghead, Bonney is caught in St. Saturn’s grasp, knowing he is responsible for her father’s transformation into a cyborg. However, Saturn reveals an even more shocking truth that throws Bonney into despair.
episodes.title: I`m Sorry, Dad - Bonney`s Tears and Kuma`s Fist

episodes.synopsis: Kuma, battered and without free will, approaches Bonney. Overcome with emotion, she tells him she saw all his memories and learned everything that he did for her. Watching the scene, Vegapunk wonders what compelled Kuma to come to Egghead.
episodes.title: Thank You, Dad - Bonney and Kuma`s Warm Embrace

episodes.synopsis: As an order comes down to evacuate the island in preparation for bombardment, Navy soldiers rush to their ships. Meanwhile, Vegapunk pleads with Saturn to halt the attack, arguing how vital the island is for the future of humanity, but Saturn refuses to listen.
episodes.title: Destroy Egghead - The Buster Call Is Invoked

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk reveals the secret he alone has been keeping regarding the Pacifistas. Meanwhile, Bonney, her back against the wall, hears a familiar rhythm. It’s the rhythm that her father taught her along with the legend of the hero he admired.
episodes.title: An Admired Hero - The Warrior of Liberation Who Saves Bonney

episodes.synopsis: The Giant Pirate Crew led by Dorry and Brogy arrive at Egghead, which deeply moves Usopp and the others. Zoro keeps fighting Rob Lucci and the Pacifistas continues to torment the Navy while Luffy shows Bonney how to throw a real punch.
episodes.title: Reliable Reinforcements! Dorry and Brogy Arrive!

episodes.synopsis: Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.
episodes.title: Come In, World - Vegapunk`s Message

episodes.synopsis: Suddenly, Vegapunk’s broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.
episodes.title: Vegapunk`s Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast

episodes.synopsis: Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.
episodes.title: The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together

episodes.synopsis:
Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St.
Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but
St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.
episodes.title: Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph

episodes.synopsis: Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk’s broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.
episodes.title: An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison`s Resolve

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk’s broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.
episodes.title: A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk`s Great Prediction

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk's revelation sends shockwaves around the world. St. Saturn abandons his fight with Nami and the others and rushes to stop the broadcast at all costs. Vegapunk goes on to expose another stunning truth, this time about Joyboy, the first pirate.
episodes.title: The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate

episodes.synopsis: The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.
episodes.title: The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk’s revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.
episodes.title: Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates

episodes.synopsis: Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. Aboard the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.
episodes.title: Her and Her Father`s Dream! Bonney`s Free Future

episodes.synopsis: Zoro and the others who are on the Sunny in the Labophase finally attempt to escape, but at the cost of an unexpected sacrifice. Meanwhile, as Vegapunk concludes his speech, Bonney once again faces St. Saturn, the object of her great hatred.
episodes.title: Her Father and Mother`s Legacy! Bonney`s Nika Punch

episodes.synopsis: Vegapunk's speech raises the spirits of the pirates across the world, infuriating the Navy and the civilians. However, the broadcast is suddenly cut off while Vegapunk is still speaking. Meanwhile, off the coast of Egghead, the Five Elders are about to deliver the Straw Hats and the Giants a deadly strike.
episodes.title: The Upheaval of an Era! The Color of the Supreme King That Leads Luffy

episodes.synopsis: Two weeks before the battle erupted on Egghead, Vegapunk found out someone stole a portion of the Mother Flame. Along with Pythagoras and Shaka, he launched an investigation and identified the culprit, also learning their shocking motivation. Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.
episodes.title: The Truth Behind the Secret Plan - Vegapunk Claims Victory

episodes.synopsis: York wakes up to see Island Clouds rising, and to her surprise, something is about to be taken away. Meanwhile, at Mary Geoise, the Celestial Dragons realize their food stock is dwindling and become belligerent. Another one of Vegapunk’s Satellites, Lilith wakes up and receives astonishing news.
episodes.title: The Promised Horizon - Off to the Long-Awaited Elbaph!

episodes.synopsis: A reunion banquet with the comrades of the Giant Pirate Crew! They raise their glasses and feast upon giant platters of food. Their destination is the long-awaited Elbaph. Brimming with anticipation for the new adventure, Luffy and his crew surge forward across the vast sea!
episodes.title: The Long-Sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!

episodes.synopsis: Nami awakens to find herself in a completely unfamiliar place. Giant creatures attack one after another, driving her into a corner. At that moment, she hears a voice calling her name.
episodes.title: Nami in a Fix! An Adventure in Block Kingdom

episodes.synopsis: Luffy and the others come across a warrior riding a grasshopper.
episodes.title: A Quest in the Land of Mystery! The Secret of the Sun God

episodes.synopsis: Pursued by the Sun God, the Straw Hats flee across Block Kingdom at full speed. Amidst the chaos, the Sun God's true objective begins to surface. But as they run, another wall blocks their path. Their breakthrough rests on Luffy’s fists.
episodes.title: Destroy the Miniature Garden - Escape Block Kingdom!

episodes.synopsis: Leaving the Block Kingdom behind, Luffy and the others find themselves facing a vast snowy landscape and a massive suspension bridge. They resolve to move forward, only to be halted by approaching figures and a mysterious roar.
episodes.title: An Encounter on a Snowfield - Loki, the Accursed Prince

episodes.synopsis: Luffy encounters Loki, the Accursed Prince, who offers him a deal. He hints at a connection to Shanks, all while savage beasts crowd around, staring Luffy down. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others on the suspension bridge realize someone is following them.
episodes.title: A Dangerous Deal! Loki of the Underworld and Luffy

episodes.synopsis: Luffy meets up with Gerd and Goldberg. They arrive just after Zoro and Sanji had managed to trap Road. As they explore, Luffy's group reunites with Hajrudin, Dorry, Brogy and the other Straw Hats.
episodes.title: A Gargantuan Wave of Emotion - The Dreamlike Scenery of Elbaph

episodes.synopsis: Robin and the others finally arrive at the port of the Western Village in Elbaph.
episodes.title: I Want You to Praise Me - The Reunion of Robin and Saul

episodes.synopsis: Robin formally introduces Luffy and the others to Saul. Then his assistant, Ange, shows them around the school, where Usopp is shocked by the education being provided there. Meanwhile, Robin is taken to the library by Saul, where she is met with an incredible sight.
episodes.title: Saul`s Resolve - The Inherited Will of Ohara

episodes.synopsis: Robin, Chopper, Bonney, and Lilith enjoy the Owl Library.
episodes.title: A Welcome with Friends` Cups and Intruders Seeking Loki

episodes.synopsis: As the Straw Hats converse with the Giants, they learn about Nika and Loki. Luffy, Zoro and Nami have Road assist them in the search for Loki's key. Meanwhile, two cryptic individuals approach Loki, seeking an offer.
episodes.title: Encountering Loki - Gunko of the Knights of God

episodes.synopsis: The Straw Hats, Luffy, Nami, and Zoro arrive at the massive Aurust Castle in Elbaf. Meanwhile, Prince Loki is brutally beaten by Gunko for refusing to join the God's Knights, and Figarland Shamrock finally reveals his face.
episodes.title: Shamrock Appears - Commander of the Knights of God

episodes.synopsis: Leaving behind a brutal parting gift, Shamrock and Gunko of the Knights of God abandon Loki and move on to their next strategy. Meanwhile, Franky is shown old wall paintings, and Robin reads an important religious text passed down since ancient times in Elbaph.
episodes.title: Ancient History - The Harley Passed Down by Elbaph

episodes.synopsis: While exploring the abandoned castle, Luffy and the others find a strange mark on the floor of the throne room and hear a mysterious voice out of nowhere. At the banquet, Oimo tells Usopp the tale of a legendary man linked to the Pirate King.
episodes.title: The Legend Lurking in Elbaph - The Identity of the Mountain-Eater

episodes.synopsis: Gaban challenges Luffy to try to take the key from him. Luffy goes for it, only to be overpowered by Gaban's sheer force. Meanwhile, Shamrock and Gunko summon reinforcements and plot a detailed strategy to disorient the Giants.
episodes.title: Get the Key! Luffy vs. Scopper Gaban

episodes.synopsis: While observing the Jewel Tree Adam along with Ripley, Franky learns of Elbaph’s weak points. Meanwhile, in the Underworld, Luffy and Zoro find a heavily injured Loki. As they argue over whether to unchain him, an unexpected turn of events blindsides them.
episodes.title: The Heinous Sinner - Loki of the Underworld Freed?!

episodes.synopsis: A massive snake suddenly attacks the Walrus School. Saul and the other teachers stand their ground to protect the children, but just then, another mystery strikes, plunging the school into pure panic.
episodes.title: Monsters Appear in Elbaph - "What I Fear Most"

episodes.synopsis: Saul tries to stop the marching children, but as he reaches out to them, some unknown force gets in his way. Meanwhile, hearing the school’s emergency call throws Dorry and the others at the Western Village into disarray, just as a monster appears before them as well.
episodes.title: A Nightmarish Game - The Dark Plot of the Knights of God

episodes.synopsis: Join Luffy and his crew on thrilling high seas adventures, battling foes and forming unbreakable bonds.
episodes.title: Save the Children! The Elbaph Warriors Rise Up

episodes.synopsis: In the Underworld, Loki talks about a pirate he idolized when he was young. Meanwhile, in the Sun World, the marching children get closer to the fire. The Elbaph Fire Brigade tries to extinguish the flames, while others beg the children to stop. When all hope seems lost, a lone savior arrives to turn the tide.
episodes.title: Elbaph in Flames! Jinbe`s Shoulder Throw Explodes!

episodes.synopsis: Gunko from the Knights of God shows up right in front of Nami and the others and reveals to them that their plan is to take the children to Mary Geoise. Enraged, the Straw Hats launch an attack, only to be completely overwhelmed by Gunko's extraordinary power.
episodes.title: The Threat of the Arrow-Arrow Fruit - Gunko vs. the Straw Hats

episodes.synopsis: Nami and the others are now captured by Gunko, and Brook receives a demand he never saw coming. Meanwhile, Sommers from the Knights of God begins speaking to all of Elbaph and reveals their true objective.
episodes.title: A Despicable Hostage Game - Sommers`s Brazen Demands

episodes.synopsis: One of the marching children, Ronja, is suddenly separated from the group, and Sommers presses Jarul to make an impossible choice. As the Giants bicker over what to do, Robin launches into a reckless move.
episodes.title: Protect History and the Future - Robin and Gaban Go on the Attack

episodes.synopsis: Scopper Gaban, the Pirate King's Left Arm, appears before the captured and immobilized Straw Hats, launching a counteroffensive against the Knights of God. Gunko, however, uncovers his weakness.
episodes.title: One Do-or-Die Second - Gaban vs. the Knights of God

episodes.synopsis: Filled with rage, Dorry, Brogy, and their fellow Giants charge at the Knights of God. However, blocked by their dark powers, the Giants are unable to go rescue the children. Nami and the others remain captive, while Luffy and his group are completely unaware in the Underworld. Elbaph is plunged into an absolute crisis.
episodes.title: Elbaph in Despair - Diabolical Covenant, "Domi Reversi"

info.synopsis: Monkey D. Rufy è un giovane pirata sognatore che da piccolo ha inavvertitamente mangiato il frutto del diavolo Gom Gom che lo rende "elastico", permettendogli di allungarsi e deformarsi a piacimento, a scapito, però, della capacità di nuotare. L'obiettivo che lo ha spinto in mare è quello ambizioso di diventare il Re dei pirati. Dovrà, dunque, ritrovare il leggendario "One Piece", il magnifico tesoro lasciato dal mitico pirata Gol D. Roger probabilmente sull'isola di Raftel, alla fine della Rotta Maggiore, mai ritrovato e sogno di ogni pirata.Nella sua avventura, Rufy riunirà intorno a lui una ciurma e si troverà in mezzo a situazioni bizzarre e stravaganti, tanto almeno quanto lo sono i personaggi, amici o nemici, presenti nell'universo che lo circonda, che raggiungono spesso livelli assurdi e grotteschi e che donano all'opera un'atmosfera surreale e divertente.
info.title: One Piece

info.synopsis: Gli orfanotrofi sono posti orribili. Ma Earwig adora il St. Morwald perché, da quando è stata lasciata ancora in fasce all’ingresso dell’stituto, tutti fanno esattamente quello che vuole. Le cose cambiano il giorno in cui una coppia un po’ inquietante (che si sforza di apparire normale) decide di adottare proprio lei. Earwig viene così catapultata nella misteriosa abitazione di Bella Yaga e Mandragora, tra stanze segrete, pozioni e libri di magia, e non ci metterà molto a scoprire che la sua nuova ‘mamma’ è una strega, con tutte le conseguenze che ne derivano! Ma grazie alla sua intelligenza e al prezioso aiuto di Thomas, un gatto parlante, Earwig troverà il modo di farsi rispettare. Una piccola storia di grande coraggio, che insegna a non abbattersi mai, nemmeno quando tutto sembra prendere la piega sbagliata.
info.title: Earwig and the Witch

info.synopsis: Nella Terra, disastri naturali di cause sconosciute si sono verificati irregolarmente in molte aree. Pertanto, la maggior parte delle persone, per sfuggire a questi disastri naturali, è venuta a vivere in città mobili sviluppate nel corso degli anni. L'Originium lasciato sul luogo di tali catastrofi ha portato al rapido progresso della civiltà grazie alla sua immensa energia. Ma ha portato con sé anche qualcos'altro: una malattia incurabile chiamata Oripatia. Poiché i corpi di coloro che sono affetti da Oripatia si cristallizzano gradualmente e diventano una nuova fonte di infezione al momento della morte, in molti Paesi gli Infetti sono soggetti a persecuzione in regimi di segregazione e lavoro forzato. Coloro che sono stati oppressi dai governi iniziano a ribellarsi. Rhodes Island, un'azienda farmaceutica che sta ricercando una cura per l'Oripatia, prende le armi e inizia una conquista per cercare di salvare tutte le persone dalla malattia. info.synopsis: Anno 2020: da qualche tempo nel mondo sono apparsi dei misteriosi varchi verso un universo parallelo. Questa dimensione, chiamata Mato, è popolata da terribili mostri che minacciano di uscire nel mondo reale; Allo stesso tempo, tuttavia, presenta una nuova fonte di energia detta “pesche”. Le pesche, misteriosamente, sono capaci di donare incredibili poteri alle donne umane: per questo motivo gli uomini ricoprono ormai un ruolo sempre più marginale nella società. per combattere i mostri, inoltre, è stato istituito un corpo di combattimento anti-demone formato unicamente da ragazze dotate di grandi poteri grazie alle pesche. Un giorno, uno studente di nome Yuuki si ritrova improvvisamente trasportato all’interno di Mato; a correre in suo aiuto è Kyouka, capitano della settima unità anti-demoni. Riconoscendo il suo potenziale latente e avendo bisogno di lui per potenziare le abilità legate alla propria pesca, Kyouka chiede al ragazzo di unirsi al corpo di combattimento… In qualità di suo schiavo! Questo incarico, però, sembra destinato a riservare a Yuuki molti più vantaggi di quanti non si aspettasse inizialmente…
info.title: Chained Soldier

info.synopsis: La storia segue le vicende di Joe Higan, un nukenin, ovvero un ex ninja scappato dal proprio clan, e che cerca di nascondersi dal suo violento passato, vivendo nell'America più rurale con la sua famiglia. Una notte cade in un'imboscata dell'organizzazione di cui faceva parte, che richiede un tributo di sangue, a lui e alla sua famiglia, per il suo tradimento. Risvegliatosi dalla sua morte apparente, Joe tornerà ad essere Ninja Kamui per vendicare la sua famiglia e i suoi amici. Kamui è un ninja del 21° secolo, un anacronismo vivente che contrapporrà le sue antiche tecniche ad armi high-tech. Affronterà assassini ben addestrati, cyborg e altri ninja per distruggere il suo stesso clan.
info.title: Ninja Kamui

info.synopsis: Rufy e la sua ciurma raggiungono una nuova isola alla ricerca di una spada leggendaria, conosciuta come la più costosa del mondo. Presto la ciurma viene divisa da un attacco della marina. Zoro tradisce la ciurma per aiutare un vecchio amico, Saga; Rufy e Usop vagano in una grotta e il resto della ciurma aiuta un villaggio combattendo i marines. Zoro si ritroverà ad affrontare Saga e ottiene la sacra perla che rappresenta l'unica difesa contro la spada malvagia che potrebbe portare l'oscurità nel mondo.

info.synopsis: Guerre nucleari e malattie hanno flagellato e distrutto il mondo. Per evitare nuovi orrori, nel periodo futuro chiamato "Maelstrom", si cerca di creare un mondo utopico, grazie a nanotecnologie mediche e ad una potente etica del benessere sociale e di considerazione reciproca. Eppure questo mondo non è così perfetto come sembra... Tre giovani ragazze, Tuan Kirie, la sua compagna di classe Miach Mihie e la loro amica Cian Reikado, decidono di opporsi a questo totalitarismo di gentilezza e all'utilizzo di super-medicine con uno sciopero della fame, decise a portarlo avanti fino ad un tentativo estremo di suicidio. La loro protesta però fallisce. Anni dopo, Tuan Kirie, è diventata membro dell'organizzazione Mondiale della Sanità. Mentre Kirie dovrà affrontare una minaccia mondiale capace di distruggere l'intero pianeta, rincontrerà Cian. Riusciranno le due a salvare il mondo... da sé stesso?
info.title: Harmony

Nonostante la sua giovanissima età, Li Meifon possiede le qualità ed il carisma per riuscire ad imporsi come rispettatissimo comandante di "Angel Links" l'astronave lasciatale dal nonno e del suo equipaggio. Tuttavia Li Meifon è perseguitata da terribili incubi e ricordi misteriosi relativi a suo nonno ed al proprio passato ed ai veri motivi della propria esistenza.

info.synopsis: Dopo essersi diplomata al liceo, Natsuko Hirose inizia la sua carriera come animatrice. Il suo talento sboccia velocemente e viene subito notato permettendole di debuttare come regista in brevissimo tempo. Il suo primo anime diventa un enorme successo, che innesca un fenomeno sociale che la porta a guadagnarsi il riconoscimento di genio emergente. E ora sta lavorando ad un nuovo progetto che sarà una commedia romantica incentrata sul primo amore! Tuttavia Natsuko, non essendo mai stata innamorata fatica a capire questo concetto e non riesce a creare un storyboard adatto causando un arresto alla produzione del film.

tmdb.synopsis:
A huge turtle-shapes mecha, the "Turtleking" attacks a uranium storage facility. The ISO and the delegates of various countries are very concerned. Nambu, the only person who previously knew of Galactor, now officially anounces the existence of both the criminal organization "Galactor", as well as the Science Ninja Team that has been formed to resist them.

The Science Ninja Team receives Nambu's orders, unites in the God Phoenix, and flies off right away to a missile launching base where the mecha was sighted.

Ken stops Joe, who's eager to get into his first real fight. Ken takes Jun along and they sneak inside the mecha. With Ken's help the God Phoenix then enters the mecha and Joe, Jinpei and Ryu join the battle against the Galactor members.

Elsewhere, the commander of the mecha tells Berg Katse of the Science Ninja Team's existence. Katse then relays the message to Governor X. In accordance with X's instructions, Katse orders the Science Ninja Team to be destroyed.

The order is to have the mecha make a suicidal plunge, taking the God Phoenix with it, thus burying the Science Ninja Team. But at the very last moment, the God Phoenix escapes the mecha by using the Firebird Effect.
tmdb.title: Allarme rosso per i Silos a.k.a. Gatchaman contro Turtle King

tmdb.synopsis:
A spaceship disappears, along with a device that can report and record the location of the Earth's resources.

The Science Ninja Team receives Nambu's instructions and heads towards the bottom of the sea, in the vicinity of the spot where contact with the spaceship was lost. There, prawn-shaped bulldozers leave a huge aircraft carrier located on the sea bottom to build a uranium factory. Ken stops Ryu who wants to fire a Bird Missile, and sneaks into the aircraft carrier alone.

Ken discovers the spaceship's capsule inside the aircraft carrier, but the astronauts have been taken hostage. Ken is caught then too. In reality however, the pilots have already been murdered. Showing them as if they were still alive has been a trap.

Jinpei has sneaked into the aircraft carrier following Ken on Joe's orders. He is able to rescue Ken as he is being led underground. The two of them collect the device and escape, destroying the computer in the aircraft carrier.

The commander of the carrier gets blamed by Katse, and he gets into the head of the Turtleking to hurl himself at the God Phoenix. But due to Ken's quick thinking, the God Phoenix becomes the Firebird and the flames consume everything.

tmdb.synopsis:
Deadly crashes involving passenger planes keep happening. Ken, who's investigating these occurrences, encounters a boy named Makoto. The boy is awaiting the return of his father who was reported missing in one of the accidents.

Makoto's father is the younger brother of the inventor of Uranless, Dr. Takahara. The string of plane crashes has been caused by Galactor. They are intent on getting the Uranless, since it is capable of neutralizing the means of propulsion of their giant mummy.

Ken has encountered the mummy in his Cessna before, and because of that incident, he has data concerning the propulsion system of the mummy. He contacts Dr. Takahara in order to get the Uranless.

He meets Makoto's father, who miraculously survived the crash. But it's Katse in disguise. Katse battles with Ken and escapes. Makoto blames Ken for torturing his father and Ken promises him to bring back his father whereupon he gets the pin hiding the Uranless.

The giant mummy appears at the airport and Ken is able to defeat it by firing the Uranless into it. But Makoto watches Katse, still in the guise of his father, flee in an escape rocket. He accuses Ken of breaking his promise to bring his father back.

Ken accepts Makoto's hate silently since he lost his father ten years before in a similar way and has had the same thoughts - namely that his father would return some day.
tmdb.title: Incidenti aerei a Zarkadia a.k.a. La tempesta evocata dalla mummia gigante

info.synopsis:
Remake degli episodi 1, 11 e 105 della serie televisiva del 1972.
Nel primo episodio, la squadra di Gachaman dovrà affrontare una razza aliena di nome Galactor intenzionata a distruggere un progetto che prevede l'unificazione delle risorse energetiche del mondo.
Nel secondo episodio vedremo nuovamente i Galactor come antagonisti, ma questa volta alla squadra di Gatchaman si uniranno un misterioso guerriero e le persone al suo seguito.
Il terzo e ultimo OAV è dedicato all'ultimo e più pericoloso scontro di Gatchaman in cui verrà deciso una volta per tutte il destino dell'umanità.

info.synopsis: Benvenuti nella città murata di Kowloon, a Hong Kong, e nei suoi sovrappopolati bassifondi: un paesaggio urbano distopico dove le persone traboccano di nostalgia ed il passato, presente e futuro convergono. Qui Reiko Kujirai vi lavora come agente immobiliare, e sviluppa una certa affezione per il collega Hajime Kudō. La donna non ricorda nulla del proprio passato, ma quando un giorno rinviene una peculiare fotografia, scopre che un tempo l'uomo aveva una relazione con una donna d'aspetto proprio identico a lei. Un frammento per volta, tra le memorie nascoste del passato, Reiko scoprirà l'altra sé stessa, assieme a un grande segreto celato a Kowloon.
info.title: Kowloon Generic Romance

info.synopsis: La storia prende le mosse nel 1989 con la notizia che Dio Brando, dato per morto dopo lo scontro finale con Jonathan Joestar al termine della Prima serie, è in realtà ancora vivo: la sua testa, staccatasi dal corpo, riuscì negli ultimi attimi prima dell'esplosione ad appropriarsi del corpo di Jonathan Joestar, per poi rinchiudersi in una bara e sprofondare nelle profondità marine. Quasi cento anni dopo, la bara viene recuperata e portata in superficie da un gruppo di incauti marinai. Il nuovo JoJo, Jotaro Kujo, nipote giapponese di Joseph Joestar, scopre di essere un portatore di "Stand": una estensione del corpo e della mente del suo portatore, generata dalla sua stessa energia vitale. Questo potere è risvegliato nella famiglia Joestar dai "segnali di pericolo" inviati dal corpo di Jonathan Joestar, di cui Dio Brando si è impadronito. Lo Stand, i cui poteri differiscono da persona a persona, viene controllato con successo da Jotaro (Star Platinum) e Joseph (Hermit Purple), ma rischia di uccidere Holly Joestar, la madre di Jotaro e figlia di Joseph: l'unico rimedio per evitare la morte è uccidere la fonte del male, Dio Brando, che dimora in un antico palazzo de Il Cairo, in Egitto. Inizia così un avventuroso viaggio dal Giappone fino all'Egitto attraverso l'Asia e l'India, nel quale Jotaro e il suo gruppo di alleati portatori di Stand (tra cui l'ultrasessantenne Joseph Joestar) affrontano numerosi nemici anch'essi dotati di Stand, al servizio di Dio Brando.
info.title: Le Bizzarre Avventure di JoJo: Stardust Crusaders 2 (ITA)

info.synopsis: Welsh è un giovane di campagna con una grande passione per la cucina, mentre Shedar è un giovane principe destinato a diventare re. Un incontro casuale fa incrociare le loro vite, molto diverse tra loro. Insieme scopriranno che il loro destino è strettamente legato. Dovranno collaborare per fermare un crudele despota intenzionato a conquistare il mondo. Solo unendo le loro forze potranno riportare la pace.
info.title: Welsh & Shedar
